SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.SaltCheck.finsetSum_satisfiable : ∃ s f,
  SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.h2_sign_cfg (SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.finsetSum s f) ∧

SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.SaltCheck.finsetSum_summand_load_bearing : ∃ s f,

SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.SaltCheck.family_one_h2 : SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.h2_sign_cfg
  (SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.familyConfig 1)
@SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.finsetSum_productLemma : ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.WeilConfig),
  SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.h2_sign_cfg (SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.finsetSum s f) ↔
    ∀ i ∈ s, SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.h2_sign_cfg (f i)
SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.family_theorem : ∀ (q : ℕ) [inst : NeZero q],
  SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.h2_sign_cfg (SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.familyConfig q) ↔
    ∀ χ ∈ SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.family q, SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.GRH_chi χ.primitiveCharacter

SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.family_three_statement : SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.FamilyTheorem 3 =
  (SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.h2_sign_cfg (SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.familyConfig 3) ↔
    ∀ χ ∈ SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.family 3, SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.GRH_chi χ.primitiveCharacter)
SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.familyConfig_arith : ∀ (q : ℕ) [inst : NeZero q] (k : ℝ → ℂ),
  (SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.familyConfig q).rhs k =
    ∑ χ ∈ SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.family q,
      (SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.archTerm_chi χ.primitiveCharacter k -
        SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.primeSum_chi χ.primitiveCharacter k)
SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.gammaBracket_conductor : ∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (r : ℝ),
  SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.gammaBracket_chi χ.primitiveCharacter r =
    Real.log (↑χ.conductor / Real.pi) +
      (1 / 4 + ↑(SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.parity χ.primitiveCharacter) / 2 + Complex.I * ↑r / 2).digamma.re
SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.zeta_rhs_pole : ∀ (k : ℝ → ℂ),
  SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.zetaWeilConfig.rhs k =
    SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.poleTerm k - SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.primeSum k + SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.archTerm k
def SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.FamilyTheorem : (q : ℕ) → [NeZero q] → Prop :=
fun q [NeZero q] =>
  SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.h2_sign_cfg (SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.familyConfig q) ↔
    ∀ χ ∈ SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.family q, SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.GRH_chi χ.primitiveCharacter
def SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.TrivialSummandPremise : Prop :=
∀ (k : ℝ → ℂ),
  SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.zetaWeilConfig.rhs k =
    SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.archTerm_chi 1 k - SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.primeSum_chi 1 k
def SIDEExplicitFormula.Schema.Family.EulerFactorPremise : (q : ℕ) → [NeZero q] → Prop :=
fun q [NeZero q] =>
  ∀ (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q),
    χ ≠ 1 →
      ∀ (k : ℝ → ℂ),
        SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.archTerm_chi χ k - SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.primeSum_chi χ k =
          SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.archTerm_chi χ.primitiveCharacter k -
            SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.primeSum_chi χ.primitiveCharacter k
